intents.title: Docs
intents.example: write API docs, README, ADRs, docstrings for the auth module
intents.summary: Write or update documentation — API docs, README, ADRs, or docstrings.
interview: What should get documented — a specific module, endpoint, or the whole repo?
Who's the audience — other engineers, API consumers, or both?
Any existing docs to update rather than write fresh, or a format/style to match?

intents.title: Bug fix
intents.example: fix the /login endpoint returning 500 on missing password
intents.summary: Reproduce a specific defect, diagnose it, fix it, add a regression test.
interview: Describe the bug in one sentence — the observed behavior.
What is the expected behavior instead?
Any files you already know are involved? (I'll grep otherwise)
How will we know it's fixed?

intents.title: Feature — extend
intents.example: add a ?filter param to the existing /users endpoint
intents.argument_hint: [the capability to add, in one line]
intents.summary: Add a capability to an existing endpoint or module.
interview: Which existing endpoint or module are we extending?
What's the new capability, in one sentence?
Any constraints — backward compatibility, existing callers not to break?

intents.title: Feature — new
intents.example: add a webhooks module (endpoint, storage, retry loop)
intents.argument_hint: [the subsystem to add, in one line]
intents.summary: Design and add a new subsystem — endpoint, storage, and tests together.
interview: What's the new subsystem, in one sentence — what does it do?
What does it need — storage, an endpoint, background jobs, retries?
How should it be tested — unit only, or an integration path too?

intents.title: Refactor
intents.example: extract shared date logic into a util module and update all call sites
intents.summary: Extract shared logic and update call sites, verified by the full test suite.
interview: What are we refactoring, and where does the duplication or mess live?
What must the behavior guarantee stay identical afterward?
Any call sites you already know will need updating?

intents.title: Test backfill
intents.example: backfill unit tests for src/payments to reach 80% line coverage
intents.argument_hint: [what to backfill coverage for, in one line]
intents.summary: Backfill test coverage toward a stated target.
interview: Which module or path needs test coverage?
What's the target — a coverage percentage, specific untested branches, or both?
Any existing test patterns or conventions in this repo to follow?

intents.title: Dependency upgrade
intents.argument_hint: [the dependency + target version, in one line]
intents.summary: Upgrade a dependency and patch the breaking-change fallout it causes.
interview: Which dependency, and from what version to what version?
Any breaking changes you already know about from the changelog?
Anything explicitly out of scope — other dependencies not to touch this run?
